title: Postgres logs and events
description: Pod logs of managed Postgres, FerretDB and Babelfish services and the marketplace events about them (backups, reconciliation, autoscaling).

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.definition:
SELECT service, if(argMaxIf(name, time, name != '') AS service_name != '', service_name, service) FROM (
  SELECT Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, Attributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'] AS name, TimeUnix AS time FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName = 'cnpg_collector_up'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'], '', Timestamp FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['provider'] IN ('postgres', 'ferretdb', 'babelfish')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'], LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'], Timestamp FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'postgres'
) WHERE service != '' GROUP BY service ORDER BY service_name, service

  UNION ALL
  SELECT LogAttributes['targetId'], '', Timestamp FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['provider'] IN ('postgres', 'ferretdb', 'babelfish')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'], LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'], Timestamp FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['container'] = 'postgres'
) WHERE service != '' GROUP BY service ORDER BY service_name, service

panels.title: Events

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, multiIf(SeverityNumber >= 17, 'error', SeverityNumber >= 13, 'warning', 'info') AS level, count() AS value
FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] IN (${service:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, level ORDER BY time

panels.description: Marketplace events about the selected services, by severity.

panels.title: Event log

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Timestamp AS Time, multiIf(SeverityNumber >= 17, 'error', SeverityNumber >= 13, 'warning', 'info') AS Severity, if(EventName != '', EventName, LogAttributes['event.name']) AS Event, LogAttributes['targetId'] AS Service, LogAttributes['name'] AS Name,
  Body AS Message, LogAttributes['creator'] AS Creator
FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'marketplace' AND LogAttributes['targetId'] IN (${service:singlequote})
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 500

panels.description: Backups, reconciliation and autoscaling, as the marketplace records them.

panels.title: Log lines by level

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, multiIf(
    JSONExtractString(Body, 'record', 'error_severity') IN ('ERROR', 'FATAL', 'PANIC'), 'error',
    JSONExtractString(Body, 'record', 'error_severity') = 'WARNING', 'warning',
    JSONExtractString(Body, 'record', 'error_severity') != '', 'info',
    JSONExtractString(Body, 'level') IN ('error', 'fatal', 'panic'), 'error',
    JSONExtractString(Body, 'level') IN ('warn', 'warning'), 'warning',
    JSONExtractString(Body, 'level') = 'debug', 'debug',
    multiSearchAnyCaseInsensitive(Body, ['error', 'fatal', 'panic']), 'error',
    'info') AS level, count() / $__interval_s AS value
FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] IN (${service:singlequote}) AND LogAttributes['pod'] IN (${pod:singlequote})
  AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(Body, '$search') > 0, $search)
GROUP BY time, level ORDER BY time

panels.description: Lines per second. Postgres messages are classified by their error_severity, operator lines by their level.

panels.title: Top Postgres errors

targets.rawSql:
SELECT JSONExtractString(Body, 'record', 'error_severity') AS Severity, JSONExtractString(Body, 'record', 'sql_state_code') AS `SQL state`, JSONExtractString(Body, 'record', 'message') AS Message,
  count() AS Count, uniqExact(LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id']) AS Services, max(Timestamp) AS `Last seen`
FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] IN (${service:singlequote}) AND LogAttributes['pod'] IN (${pod:singlequote})
  AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(Body, '$search') > 0, $search) AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'record', 'error_severity') IN ('ERROR', 'FATAL', 'PANIC')
GROUP BY Severity, `SQL state`, Message ORDER BY Count DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: ERROR, FATAL and PANIC messages Postgres logged, grouped by message.

panels.title: Logs

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Timestamp AS timestamp, multiIf(
    JSONExtractString(Body, 'record', 'message') != '', concat(JSONExtractString(Body, 'record', 'error_severity'), ': ', JSONExtractString(Body, 'record', 'message')),
    JSONExtractString(Body, 'msg') != '', JSONExtractString(Body, 'msg'),
    Body) AS body, multiIf(
    JSONExtractString(Body, 'record', 'error_severity') IN ('ERROR', 'FATAL', 'PANIC'), 'error',
    JSONExtractString(Body, 'record', 'error_severity') = 'WARNING', 'warning',
    JSONExtractString(Body, 'record', 'error_severity') != '', 'info',
    JSONExtractString(Body, 'level') IN ('error', 'fatal', 'panic'), 'error',
    JSONExtractString(Body, 'level') IN ('warn', 'warning'), 'warning',
    JSONExtractString(Body, 'level') = 'debug', 'debug',
    multiSearchAnyCaseInsensitive(Body, ['error', 'fatal', 'panic']), 'error',
    'info') AS level,
  LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] AS service, LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/name'] AS service_name, LogAttributes['pod'] AS pod, LogAttributes['container'] AS container,
  JSONExtractString(Body, 'logger') AS logger, JSONExtractString(Body, 'record', 'user_name') AS user, JSONExtractString(Body, 'record', 'database_name') AS database
FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['managed-services.codesphere.com/id'] IN (${service:singlequote}) AND LogAttributes['pod'] IN (${pod:singlequote})
  AND $__conditionalAll(positionCaseInsensitive(Body, '$search') > 0, $search)
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 1000
